decisions.reason: The reference-class electrometer is at the heart of the firm's dosimetry and accredited calibration knowledge, so the firm can readily interpret its results and improve it, and its flagship status makes withdrawal very unlikely.
The CT image quality phantom extends the firm's established phantom and measurement expertise into imaging QA, where its physicists can assimilate customer feedback, so it fits the stated direction.

Mammography QA is further from the firm's radiation therapy dosimetry core, which limits how well it can interpret early results, but it complements the flagship imaging QA line and is still too new to judge, so it is kept for now.

The full field mammography phantom overlaps with Product D in an area where the firm's prior knowledge is thinner, which raises the risk of consolidation, but it supports the imaging QA push and has had little time to prove itself.
The imaging QA instrument line is a flagship focus that builds on the firm's measurement, software integration and support capabilities, so it has strong absorptive backing and strategic priority.
